from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial data extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2025 Q1)")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue")
    operating_total_cost: float | None = Field(description="Operating Total Cost")
    net_profit_attributable: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancialData]
